title: NCBI Submission Protocol for SARS-CoV-2 Wastewater Data
author: Ruth Timme
materials: Bookmark the link to your Submission Portal 1.
Create an NCBI user account at NCBI: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/account

steps.title: Set up NCBI User Account and Group
steps.instruction: Establish the necessary administrative accounts and user groups to manage laboratory data ownership.

substeps.instruction: Create an NCBI user account.

Establish an NCBI submission user group by emailing submit-help@ncbi.nlm.nih.gov with: short name (abbreviation), full name, contact email(s), institution/department, physical address including country, and primary contact person's name and email.
If applicable, request ownership change of existing submissions to the new user group in the same email.
Accept the group invitation via the link sent in the email titled 'NCBI Submission Portal Group invitation'.
Bookmark the Submission Portal link: https://submit.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/groups/ and the 'my submissions' page: https://submit.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/subs/.

steps.title: Create a New BioProject
steps.instruction: Create a data BioProject to organize project-related submissions, linking it to an existing umbrella BioProject if applicable.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to https://submit.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/subs/ and click 'BioProject' in the 'Start a new submission' box, then click 'New submission'.
SUBMITTER tab: Select the appropriate submission group name and describe the submitting organization or laboratory.
PROJECT TYPE tab: Set Project data type to 'Raw sequence reads' and 'metagenome'; set Sample scope to 'Environment'.
TARGET tab: Enter 'wastewater metagenome' for the Environmental sample name; leave strain info fields blank.
GENERAL INFO tab: Select 'Release immediately following processing'. Enter Project Title, Public Description, and set Relevance to 'Environmental'.

In GENERAL INFO tab, select 'Yes' for being part of a larger initiative, enter 'GenomeTrakr wastewater project' as the Initiative Description, and provide the umbrella BioProject accession (e.g., PRJNA757291).
Add external links to the laboratory website and relevant grant information.
BioSample tab: Leave blank.
Publications tab: Include relevant laboratory publications if applicable.
Review and Submit tab: Verify details and click 'Submit'.
Note the BioProject accession (PRJNAxxxxxx) provided via email or the 'my submissions' page.
Alert the coordinating body (e.g., GenomeTrakr) that a new BioProject was created under their umbrella.

steps.title: Prepare Metadata Templates
steps.instruction: Download and populate the required Excel templates for BioSample and SRA metadata.

substeps.instruction: Populate the BioSample custom wastewater template (BioSample_ww_template_v1.8.xlsx) following NWSS/GenomeTrakr guidance. Skip antibiogram sections.
Populate the SRA custom extension metadata template (SRA_ww_template_v5.6.xlsx).
For sample naming: Create a base ID (e.g., LABID_001) and add an index for each extraction (e.g., LABID_001.01). Ensure every Sample Name is unique.
For submissions to previously-registered BioSamples: In the SRA template, change the first column name from 'sample_name' to 'biosample_accession' and enter the SAMN#s.

steps.title: Submit BioSample and SRA Data
steps.instruction: Upload the sequence reads and associated metadata to the NCBI SRA and BioSample databases.

substeps.instruction: Go to the SARS-CoV-2 landing page (https://submit.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sarscov2/) and click 'Submit' under the SRA option (or use https://submit.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/subs/ -> 'BioSample' -> 'New Submission' for BioSample-only submissions).
Click 'New submission'.
SUBMITTER tab: Select the submission group and describe the submitting organization/laboratory; click 'Continue'.
GENERAL INFO tab: Select 'Yes' for BioProject and paste the BioProject accession. Select 'NO' for BioSample.

Set Release date: For the first submission of a BioProject, choose 'Release on specified date' (1 week in the future) to allow for human-read scrubbing. For subsequent submissions, choose 'Release immediately following processing'.
BIOSAMPLE TYPE tab: Select 'SARS-CoV-2: wastewater surveillance'.
BIOSAMPLE ATTRIBUTES tab: Upload the populated BioSample_template Excel file. Resolve any red 'errors' and review yellow 'Warnings' before clicking 'Continue'.
SRA metadata tab: Upload the populated SRA metadata template Excel file. Resolve any red 'errors' and review yellow 'Warnings' before clicking 'Continue'.
Files tab: Upload sequence files via web browser, FTP, or Aspera.
REVIEW & SUBMIT tab: Review the entire submission and click 'Submit'.

steps.title: Finalize Submission and Accessions
steps.instruction: Retrieve accessions and trigger human-read scrubbing if required.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve BioSample accessions (SAMNxxxxxxxx) and SRA run accessions (SRRxxxxxxx) from the 'my submissions' page or via email (usually within 2 hours).

If the human-read scrubbing flag is needed (first submission): Email sra@ncbi.nlm.nih.gov requesting the 'human read scrubbing analysis flag' be added to the BioProject and the HUPed SRA submissions be released, listing the accessions.
